'''Sleta Suke''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] who was the daughter of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orto/Legends|Orto's]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After Suke became engaged, a lavish engagement party was held in her honor in the [[Ortolan embassy]] on Coruscant. However, Suke secretly wanted to run away with [[Trunks Bibo]], the leader of the [[Lost Ones]] street gang, and during the party Bibo and his gang attempted to abduct Suke.<ref name="CatCW" />
